title: New Version Available
message: A newer version of Twilio Dialer is available. Update from Apps to get the latest improvements.
features: In-dialer Contacts with search, lazy pagination, Call and Detail actions
Forward To country picker with dial-code badges and E.164 preview
Calling From dropdown separated into Twilio Numbers and Caller ID
Do Not Disturb overlay that disables the dial pad while enabled
Configuration tab switching without false unsaved-changes prompts
